question: Under what condition does poison fail to enter the body even if bitten by great serpents?
premises: It is said not to enter the body.
This holds even if one has been bitten by great serpents.
inference: Poison does not enter the body even if one has been bitten by great serpents.
uncertainties: The condition that prevents poison from entering is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if bitten by great serpents.
